text: Local custody is the necessary foundation for accountable agent coordination, not a substitute for it: sovereignty returned custody to the user but did not return accountability to anyone, and whoever writes the coordination rules writes the institution.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7314479
